messages:
sonia: Marta gave notice today. Last working day 2027-06-18. Sheis on a sponsored visa; need steps for benefits, visa offboarding, archival for legal hold, and access removal. Who can own what?

marta: I'll share my visa end-date and any outstanding paperwork. Happy to help transfer admin rights; prefer email accessible a few days for references.

liam: I can own Okta/SCIM deprovision, Azure AD, and cloud keys. Need list of 3rd-party sole-admins and service accounts. Also flagging that we must coordinate with HR on visa termination timing before we cut access.

arjun: Legal: we may need to preserve Slack messages and some repos under legal hold for 90 days due to an ongoing customer audit. Tag any messages/files to legal-hold before deprovision. I'll coordinate retention scope.

sonia: Draft plan (please edit):
2022 create offboard ticket (People Ops) and note visa sponsorship end date
2022 schedule exit interview and confirm final payroll/relocation stipend (if applicable)
2022 send benefits termination + COBRA vendor packet (US) or local continuation guidance
2022 coordinate with Legal to apply hold to specified projects/messages (Arjun)
2022 Okta/SCIM disable on agreed date, but keep Google Workspace email for 72h for references (Liam)
2022 revoke cloud keys, personal PATs, and rotate shared secrets (Liam)
2022 collect device SN and shipping preference; MDM unenroll (Marta + IT)
2022 confirm visa termination notification timeline and register with immigration counsel (People Ops + Legal)

marta: Laptop SN RW-VIS-3344. I prefer to hand-deliver to office or give to courier; happy to sign the device transfer form. My sponsored visa expires 2027-07-15.

liam: Okta/SCIM commands I'll run on last day at 09:00 UTC: 
```
# deactivate user via Okta SCIM
curl -X POST "$OKTA/scim/v2/Users/$MARTA_ID/_deactivate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# disable Azure AD sign-in
az ad user update --id marta@redwood.com --account-enabled false
```
I'll delay Google Workspace suspension until 72h after last day: `gam update user marta@redwood.com suspended off` then suspend later.

arjun: Legal hold: Please add the workspace folders and repos listed in HR ticket. We'll snapshot messages and export relevant threads. For any customer-facing repo with audit data, don't delete or rotate keys until Legal confirms.

hr-bot: Created ticket HR-16721 "Marta offboard (visa-sponsored) - legal hold + device + benefits". Assigned to Sonia. Initial SLA: 2 business days.

sonia: Benefits note: Marta's healthcare coverage ends 2027-06-30 (EOM). We'll send COBRA packet 2027-06-20. For visa-related relocation stipend/questions, I'll loop in payroll and immigration counsel this afternoon.

liam: Proposed last-day timeline (2027-06-18): 09:00 Okta deactivate; 10:00 revoke PATs and personal keys; 10:15 remove from oncall/alerting groups; 11:00 rotate shared secrets (unless Legal hold blocks rotation).

arjun: If anything is under legal hold, we'll white-list it and instruct IT NOT to rotate those particular secrets until clearance. I'll update HR-16721 with scope by EOD.

marta: I'll add backups/admins to Sentry and CI today. I'll drop laptop at reception on last day unless Sonia says otherwise. Also please keep email reachable for 72 hours for reference requests.

sonia: Please add any sole-admin SaaS to HR-16721 now. Liam: once Legal posts the hold list, put a comment on the IT ticket indicating which rotations are blocked. I'll send the exit invite and immigration counsel contact. :sparkles:
